timeline: You walk out to dig a water well in 1974 and accidentally strike an 8,000-man imperial army.
Digging a simple water well in nineteen seventy four.
They exposed an entire underground army protecting an emperor.
Not a single face in the entire legion looks the same.
Every soldier was sculpted with unique hair and uniform rank.
When first unearthed, their armor shone in brilliant reds and blues.
But dry air turned the bright paint to dust in mere minutes.
More than 8,000 unique life-sized soldiers sat buried for 2,200 years until a farmer hit one with a shovel.
